title: Common Vietnamese Dishes in Pregnancy: What to Keep, Tweak, or Skip
excerpt: A nutritionist's analysis of phở, bún, cơm tấm, trứng ốp la, and street snacks — safer prep, smart pairings, and what to leave out
content:
## Introduction
When it comes to pregnancy, a well-planned diet is crucial for the health and well-being of both mother and baby. For Vietnamese women, choosing the right foods can be challenging due to the diversity of Vietnamese cuisine. In this article, we will analyze common Vietnamese dishes and provide guidance on safe preparation, smart pairings, and what to avoid.

## Analyzing Phở
Phở is one of the most popular Vietnamese dishes, and it can be a great addition to a pregnancy diet. However, it's essential to pay attention to the cooking method and ingredients. Opt for well-cooked beef or chicken, and avoid using uncooked broth. Adding vegetables and spices can also enhance the flavor and nutritional value.

## Analyzing Bún
Bún is another popular Vietnamese dish that can be enjoyed during pregnancy. However, it's crucial to choose the right type of noodles and broth. Opt for noodles made from brown rice or white rice, and avoid using uncooked broth. Adding vegetables and spices can also enhance the flavor and nutritional value.

## Analyzing Cơm Tấm
Cơm tấm is a popular dish in Southern Vietnam, and it can be a great addition to a pregnancy diet. However, it's essential to pay attention to the cooking method and ingredients. Opt for well-cooked pork or chicken, and avoid using uncooked fish sauce. Adding vegetables and spices can also enhance the flavor and nutritional value.

## Analyzing Trứng Ốp La
Trứng ốp la is a simple yet nutritious dish that can be a great addition to a pregnancy diet. However, it's essential to pay attention to the cooking method and ingredients. Opt for well-cooked eggs, and avoid using uncooked oil. Adding vegetables and spices can also enhance the flavor and nutritional value.

## Analyzing Street Snacks
Street snacks can be a fun and convenient option during pregnancy, but it's essential to choose wisely. Opt for snacks that are well-cooked and made with safe ingredients. Avoid snacks that are high in sugar, salt, or unhealthy fats.

## Combining and Limiting
When it comes to pregnancy, it's essential to combine foods in a way that provides adequate nutrition. You can combine phở with vegetables and spices, bún with vegetables and spices, cơm tấm with vegetables and spices, and trứng ốp la with vegetables and spices. However, it's essential to limit or avoid foods that are high in mercury, undercooked, or made with unsafe ingredients.

## Tips and Recommendations
When it comes to pregnancy, it's essential to prioritize nutrition and choose foods that are safe and nutritious. You can consult our [meal planner](/planner) for a personalized diet plan. Additionally, you can explore our [prenatal nutrition category](/blog/prenatal-nutrition) for more information on nutrition during pregnancy.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about your diet during pregnancy, it's essential to seek help from a healthcare provider or a registered dietitian. They can provide personalized guidance and recommendations to ensure you're getting the nutrients you need.
